supervision: original organizer GT, one anchor clip per same-game numeric team/jersey alias; unknown aliases excluded; no tracker pseudo-labels
fresh_validation: SN_game4 green/right club only; exclude shared white-blue club
fresh_test: SN_game9 both teams, all models sealed before inference
broadcast_training: SN_game6 only, distinct audited club/kit scopes
global_identity_limit: No independently verified worldwide physical-player registry. Cross-match transfers cannot be certified; do not claim that namespace IDs prove physical-player disjointness.
retrieval: Within same match/team; 3 crops from2–9s query and20–30s gallery; >=4 observed samples per window; up to8 per tracklet; identical samples across models
historical_cross_dataset: After fresh TEST finalization, evaluate locked M13 models on historical SoccerTrack M10 TEST using its original unchanged protocol; diagnostics only, no selection or tuning
data_effect: old_data_triplet versus expanded_triplet, identical generic x0.25 initializer, optimizer, step budget and loss; different identity head sizes necessarily reflect new data
objective_effect: expanded_triplet versus expanded_supcon, all other settings equal
backbone_effect: expanded_supcon versus expanded_x1_supcon; both MSMT17-person-ReID pretrained, different widths/checkpoints, not a pure parameter-count causal claim
aggregation: mean, quality weighted and learned bounded attention; choose checkpoint/method only on fresh VAL
beat_gate: M13 selected crop mAP and selected-pool tracklet mAP >=M10+0.03, crop Rank1 nonregression on identical fresh TEST
production: No activation without independent broadcast identity evidence and valid calibration; preserve M8/M9 snapshots and uncertainty
